products.name: OVERTURE PLA
products.notes: Regular PLA. overture3d.com currently sells it as 2 kg / 3 kg spools and as 1 kg spoolless 'PLA Refill' (same spec table: 190-220 C, 25-60 C, 40-70 mm/s, fan on, dry 50 C/7 h); 1 kg cardboard spools remain on Amazon. Density 1.21 g/cm3 and retraction 20-40 mm/s from OVERTURE PLA TDS V5.1 (Aug 2024). Vicat 64.2 C. Gradient (rainbow) version 'PLA Gradient' shares identical settings. 'Fan: turned on' (no % given).

products.name: OVERTURE High Speed PLA
products.notes: Product page spec table: 190-220 C nozzle, 25-60 C bed, 'Up to 300 mm/s', fan on, dry 50 C/7 h, 1 kg. No separate TDS found; density not published for this SKU (regular PLA TDS gives 1.21). Mechanical values on page are identical to regular PLA.

products.name: OVERTURE Easy PLA
products.notes: Page table: 40-60 mm/s; TDS V5.1 says 40-90 mm/s and retraction 20-40 mm/s. Density 1.20 g/cm3, Vicat 66.2 C from TDS. Fan 'turned on'.

products.name: OVERTURE Matte PLA
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 190-230 C, 50-70 C, 60-300 mm/s, fan on, retraction 30-60 mm/s. TDS lists density 1.30 and 1.31 g/cm3 in two tables (two formulation versions). 'Matte PLA Dual Colors' and 'Matte PLA Gradient' share identical settings.

products.name: OVERTURE Silk PLA
products.notes: Spec table + TDS V5.1: 200-220 C, 50-60 C, 30-70 mm/s, fan on, retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.19. Page marketing copy conflicts (190-230 C, 'no heated bed required'); spec table/TDS used. Dual-color silk (Amazon) and 'Silk PLA Gradient' share identical settings.

products.name: OVERTURE Rock PLA
products.notes: Page: 190-230 C, 50-70 C, 60-300 mm/s, fan on (FAQ: full fan). '0.4 mm Hardened Nozzle Recommended'; 'slightly more abrasive than standard PLA, but still safe for most standard setups'. Overture's 'Wood Series' colors (Cheesewood, Walnut, Jarrah, White Oak) are Rock PLA with marble dust, no wood fill. 'Rock PLA Gradient' identical. Density not published (no TDS listed).

products.name: OVERTURE Shimmer PLA
products.notes: Page table: 190-220 C, 25-60 C, 40-60 mm/s, fan on, dry 50 C/7 h. Caution: page copy and mechanical values are copied from Easy PLA, so settings may not be Shimmer-specific. No TDS; density unknown.

products.name: OVERTURE Glow PLA
products.notes: Page table: 190-220 C, 25-60 C, 40-60 mm/s, fan on, dry 50 C/7 h. The TDS link on the download page points to the Easy PLA TDS, so values may be generic. Overture does not state abrasiveness; glow pigments are commonly mildly abrasive but this is not an Overture claim. Density not published.

products.name: OVERTURE PLA Professional
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 190-220 C, 25-60 C, 40-70 mm/s, fan on, retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.27, Vicat 63.9 C. High toughness (12.8 kJ/m2). 'PLA Professional Gradient' identical.

products.name: OVERTURE PLA+
products.notes: TDS V5.2.1: 190-230 C, bed 25-60 C, <300 mm/s, fan 100%, dry 55 C/6 h, retraction 20-80 mm/s, density 1.23, Vicat 61 C. Product page spec table shows bed '25-26 C' (typo) and dry 50 C/7 h; page FAQ recommends 200-220 C nozzle, 50-60 C bed, dry 55 C/4 h. Also sold as spoolless 'PLA+ Refill' with the same table.

products.name: OVERTURE Super PLA+
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 190-230 C, 25-60 C, 40-60 mm/s, fan on, retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.21, Vicat 62.8 C. Toughness 36.6 kJ/m2.

products.name: OVERTURE Turbo PLA
products.notes: Amazon-only SKU (sold by OVERTURE 3D). Not listed on overture3d.com. Listing claims 'up to 600 mm/s, max volumetric flow 40 mm3/s' and advises lowering PEI bed temp because it sticks very well. No official nozzle/bed table found (Amazon store returned 503; reseller mirror page gone). Source is a deal-site mirror of the Amazon listing, not Overture.

products.name: OVERTURE Air PLA
products.notes: Amazon-only SKU, not on overture3d.com. Values from a retailer mirror of the Amazon listing (not Overture): 190-210 C, 25-60 C, 30-50 mm/s, density 0.9 g/cm3 at 23 C, net 0.8 kg (title says 0.82 kg). Foaming is done at the factory (no in-print expansion). Fan/drying not published.

products.name: OVERTURE High Speed PETG
products.notes: Page + PETG TDS V5.2: 230-260 C, 65-70 C, <300 mm/s, fan on, dry 60 C/5 h ('do not exceed; over-drying causes brittleness'), retraction 20-80 mm/s, density 1.3, Vicat 75 C (page FAQ says 85.1 C). Also sold as 2 kg and spoolless 'High Speed PETG Refill' with the same table. This is the only PETG on overture3d.com.

products.name: OVERTURE PETG
products.notes: Older PETG listing (OVPETG175) still on Amazon; not on overture3d.com. Values from retailer/deal-site mirrors of the Amazon text (not Overture): 230-250 C, 80-90 C, fan on, 30-50 mm/s, retraction 1-3 mm, dry >6 h at 65 C. Some mirrors now show the High Speed PETG table instead (230-260/65-70/<300), suggesting the Amazon listing was updated. Density not published.

products.name: OVERTURE TPU 95A
products.notes: Page table: 210-240 C, 35-50 C, <250 mm/s, fan on, dry 70 C/7 h. TPU 2.0 TDS: bed 25-60 C, <200 mm/s, dry 70 C/8 h, density listed as '1.18' and '1.216' (two columns, garbled). Page FAQ suggests 20-40 mm/s for Bowden/older machines; retraction off or minimal. AMS/AMS lite not compatible. Also sold as 2 kg.

products.name: OVERTURE High Speed TPU 95A
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 200-240 C, 25-60 C, 60-90 mm/s, fan on, dry 70 C/7 h ('must be dried before use'), retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.19, Shore ~95A. Direct-drive or external spool holder recommended; AMS not compatible. Also sold as 2 kg.

products.name: OVERTURE Matte TPU
products.notes: Page: 210-240 C, 35-50 C, <250 mm/s, fan on, dry 70 C/7 h. TDS: fan 100%, dry 70 C/6 h, density 1.170, Shore 95A. 'Avoid extended drying'. AMS not compatible.

products.name: OVERTURE ABS
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 245-265 C, 80-100 C, 30-70 mm/s, fan off, dry 75 C/7 h, retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.15, Vicat 103.4 C, HDT 'up to 98 C'. 'Enclosed Printer Required'; no chamber temp given. Page marketing copy conflicts (230-250 C / 90-110 C).

products.name: OVERTURE ASA
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 240-270 C, 70-95 C, 30-50 mm/s, fan off, dry 75 C/7 h (avoid over-drying), retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.14, Vicat 106.2 C. 'Enclosed Printer Required'; no chamber temp given.

products.name: OVERTURE Easy Nylon
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 245-260 C, bed 50 C (single value), 30-70 mm/s, fan off, dry 95 C/7 h, retraction 40-60 mm/s, density 1.12, Vicat 181.2 C. 'Enclosed Printer Required' (FAQ: recommended). 'Hardened Nozzle Recommended' - TDS: brass nozzle abrasion 'happens quite often', hardened steel/ruby 'highly recommended'. Anneal 70 C/2 h (TDS) or 80 C/6 h (FAQ) after printing.

products.name: OVERTURE Nylon
products.notes: Older 'OVERTURE Nylon Filament (Polyamide, PA)' still on Amazon; not on overture3d.com. Values from retailer mirror of the Amazon text (not Overture): 250-270 C, 25-50 C, fan off, 30-50 mm/s, wear-resistant (hardened steel/ruby) nozzle recommended, anneal 70 C/2 h. Tolerance +/-0.05 mm. Forum users report it as a PA6 blend. Drying/density not published.

products.name: OVERTURE PC Professional
products.notes: Page + TDS V5.1: 250-270 C, 90-105 C, 30-50 mm/s, fan off, dry 75 C/7 h, retraction 20-40 mm/s, density 1.21, Vicat 110.3-115.3 C. 'Enclosed printer required'; 'hardened steel or brass nozzle recommended'. Page copy conflicts (bed 80-100 C; dry 80 C/4-6 h).
